_doc: Đợt 2 (2026-11-26), rương Robot: tiếng bay (thẻ chip lướt như drone) và tiếng hành động (quẹt thẻ vào ổ đọc). Chạy: python3 -I Tools/Audio/make_elevenlabs_chest_sfx.py --manifest Tools/Audio/manifests/chest_robot.json

items.prompt: a tiny quadcopter drone gliding past: a smooth high-pitched electric propeller whir that rises, two quick servo zips as it snaps sideways, then the whir eases down, small synthetic chirp at the end, no music, no voice

a plastic keycard swiped hard through a metal card reader: instant sharp swish and click at the very start, then a short bright electronic double beep, a fast rising scanner sweep tone, and a soft mechanical latch clunk, no music, no voice
